en.headline: Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge half marathon draws record 10,000 entries
en.dek: The November 15 race has been upgraded to World Athletics Platinum status, the first such road race in Hong Kong.
body: More than 10,000 runners have registered for the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge half marathon on 15 November, breaking previous records, organisers said on Tuesday.

The event, organised by the Hong Kong Athletics Association, has expanded its total quota from 8,000 to 10,000 with a new 10-kilometre challenge category. The start will be at the Hong Kong Port of the bridge, with the route passing the Scenic Hill Tunnel and offering views of the airport.

Organisers said the race has been elevated to World Athletics Platinum Label Road Race status, the first marathon in Hong Kong to receive the highest rating and only the fourth half marathon worldwide to do so. The label requires strict standards on fields, anti-doping, course and technical arrangements.

zh.headline: 港珠澳大橋半馬拉松逾萬人報名破紀錄
zh.dek: 11月15日賽事升格世界田徑聯會白金級，為本港首個獲此認證的馬拉松。
body: 港珠澳大橋香港段半馬拉松將於11月15日舉行，大會周二表示今屆報名人數逾一萬，打破以往紀錄。
由中國香港田徑總會主辦的賽事新增十公里挑戰組，總名額由八千增至一萬。起步點設於港珠澳大橋香港口岸，路線途經觀景山隧道，可眺望機場景色。
大會指賽事已升格為世界田徑聯會認可的白金級道路賽事，是本港首個獲得最高級別認證的馬拉松，亦是全球第四個獲此殊榮的半馬。評定涵蓋選手陣容、藥檢、賽道及技術等嚴格標準。
